trials.text: Matrix multiplication is a fundamental operation in linear algebra that allows us to multiply two matrices together. The result of this multiplication is another matrix, which is called the product of the two matrices. The number of columns in the first matrix must be equal to the number of rows in the second matrix for the multiplication to be defined.
